defects.claim: Label htmlFor keeps the generated ID when the child supplies its own ID, so clicking the label does not focus the control
defects.scenario: A labeled Input with a caller-supplied id: its accessible name survives via aria-labelledby, but clicking the label focuses nothing
defects.cause: label htmlFor not updated to the control's explicit id

defects.claim: A boolean true slot counts as content, rendering an empty error, marking a valid field invalid and adding an empty aria description
defects.scenario: error={valid || 'Invalid value'} with a valid field yields true, so a valid input is marked invalid with an empty error description
defects.cause: shows treats true as content though React renders it as empty
